# Jabatan Kastam Diraja Malaysia (Royal Malaysian Customs Department)

> Malaysia's customs and tax administration portal providing integrated digital systems for import/export documentation, sales tax, service tax, and levy management.

Jabatan Kastam Diraja Malaysia operates multiple specialized government portals for customs clearance, tax compliance, and trade facilitation. These systems serve importers, exporters, digital service providers, and transport operators across Malaysia's trade ecosystem.

## Key Topics

- Malaysian Customs
- Import/Export Documentation
- Sales and Service Tax (SST)
- Service Tax on Digital Services
- Tax Compliance
- Customs Portal
- Tax Registration
- Levy Management
- Business Registration
- Government Portal
- Tax Returns
- Exemption Management
- System Maintenance
- Digital Services Tax

## Core Customs & Trade Systems

- [Malaysian Customs Import/Export Document System (MyCIEDS)](https://mycieds.customs.gov.my): Primary system for processing and managing import/export documentation and customs clearance in Malaysia

## Tax Registration & Compliance Portals

- [MySST - Sales and Service Tax Portal](https://mysst.customs.gov.my): Sales and Service Tax registration and compliance management system for businesses
- [MySToDS - Service Tax on Digital Services](https://mystods.customs.gov.my): Specialized portal for registering and managing service tax obligations on digital services
- [MyLVG - Low Value Goods Sales Tax System](https://mylvg.customs.gov.my): Sales tax system designed for online sellers and low value goods transactions

## Levy & Transport Operations

- [MyDLv - Levy Release System](https://mydlv.customs.gov.my/www): Levy release and management system for transport operators and customs administration
